propositions: The lifespan shutdown drain waits only on queue.join() and misses inline reconciler reviews, causing abandonment of multi-minute reviews when the queue empties
Any container stop signal (manual restart, reboot, rollback) kills in-flight reconciler reviews with ~10s timeout instead of the 1200s drain budget allocated for reviews
The reconciler lacks a cooperative stop signal, allowing new reviews to start during drain and potentially extend shutdown indefinitely
The shutdown path skipped candidates without recording them in held_back, violating the cursor low-water-mark invariant introduced by 9f63
After lifespan shutdown, the module-level _stop_requested flag persists and silently causes subsequent reconcile_once calls to review nothing while reporting candidates as scanned
